full_judgment: Admittedly the property has been dealt with by the Ministry of Works which according to the rule quoted above has been the appropriate authority to deal with the abandoned building and has in fact dealt with the same since the declaration as abandoned building without any objection from any quarter including the Ministry of Commerce and in that view of the matter it is too late in the in the day to accept the submission of the learned Additional Attorney General that some other Ministry i.e., Ministry of Commerce responsible for management, control and supervision of the building in question treating the same as commercial establishment. Furthermore, the presumption of regularity is attached to the official work as the said Ministry of Works has been dealing with the property since 1972 and has also challenging before us the propriety of the impugned judgment of the Courts below.
